page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries. Running head centred at top (Hebrew), page number top right. Large Hebrew headwords hang at the left margin of entries. Catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Ab extremitatibus terræ, Iesa.4.19. Aff. לְקִצּוֹתָיו Extremi-tatibus ejus, Exod.39.4. scribitur cum gemino ו, quasi legendum fuisset לְקִצּוֹתָיו, ut mox dicitur קִצּוֹי, sed juxta Masorethas alterum ו redundat: עַד קְצוֹתָם Usq, ad extremitates eorum, Psal.19.7.
קִצּוֹיִם [?] m.p. Extremitates: Constr. קְצוֹי־אָרֶץ In extremitatibus terra, Psal.48.11.
קִצּוֹת f.p. Idem; Exod.38.5. in quibus duobus ו est loco tertia radicalis ה, ut in חָגוֹי, à חגה.
קִיצוֹן m. Extremus: Foemin. קִיצוֹנָה Extrema; Ulterior, Exod.26.4. Est forma אִיתוֹן ab אַתָּה.
קַצָּת Chald. Pars, Finis: מִן־קַצַּת Ex parte, Dan.2.42. לְקַצַּת יַרְחִין Ad vel post finem mensium duodecim, Dan.4.26. Rabbinicè, Quidam.

מְקַצָּת f. Idem: Et partem vasorum domus Dei, Dan.1.2. וּמְקַצַּת יְמִים Et à fine dierum decem, verf.15. וּלְמִקְצַּת הַיָּמִים Et post finem dierum istorum, verf.18. וּמְקַצַּת רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת Tum pars capitum paternarum familiarum, Neh.7.70. id est, Aliqui, Quidam è primoribus, quomodo Rabbinis familiare est: Aff. וּמִקְצָתָם Et à fine istorum, i.e. exactu illis annis, Dan.1.5. juxta R.Saadiam: Alii, Pars istorum, Aliqui; Quidam ex illis.
קִצָּח masc. Melanthion; Nigella, Iesa.28. v.25. Aben Esra scribit, ejus semen esse cymino minus & nigrum.

קִצִּין masc. Dux, Ductor, Princeps: Iesa.3. v.6. וְהָיִיתֶ֫ לָנוּ לְקַצִּין Et esto nobis in Ducem, Iud.11.6. Plural. Constr. וּקְצִינֵי Et principes domus Israël, Mich.3.1. Aff. כָּל־קְצִינָיִךְ Omnes duces tui, Iesa.22. verf.3.
קִצַּע Hiph. הִקְצִיעַ Tectorio nudavit, Lituram vel superficiem muri abstulit: Futurum,

page.notes: Headwords in large Hebrew type at the left are entry words, not headings. Vowel points on several Hebrew forms (e.g. קִצּוֹיִם, running head, final catchword) are uncertain and marked [?]. Italic and roman distinctions in short abbreviations are approximate.
